theme.name: Gallery
theme.style: Collectible-card key art for a deck that teaches image-making. Each card demonstrates exactly one technique, and the image is MADE WITH that technique wherever the brief names one - the technique is how the picture is rendered, never an object shown inside it. One strong, instantly readable focal subject with clean uncluttered edges, composed square with generous breathing room, and it still reads at thumbnail size. The artwork is full-bleed and fills the entire square to every edge, the scene cut off by the picture edges on all four sides: no border, no margin, no matting, no frame, no drawn edge line, no vignette box, no rounded corners, not a picture of a card or a page. Artwork only: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable symbols, no ui labels, no card frame, no speech bubbles, no watermarks, no signatures.

P.prompt: Protagonist. A casting line of silhouetted figures in a rehearsal hall, one stepped forward into a single warm spotlight, the chosen subject sharp and lit while the line behind stays in soft shadow.
P.alt: A spotlight picking one figure out of a casting line.
P.bio: One subject steps forward and the rest of the scene agrees to be background. Every strong image starts by choosing.

I.prompt: Illumination. A plaster bust on a sculptor's stand in a dark studio, one hard window beam carving its features out of the black, dust hanging bright in the shaft - the light visibly building the form.
I.alt: A single window beam carving a bust from darkness.
I.bio: Before color, before style, there is where the light comes from. Illumination is the scene deciding what you get to see.

C.prompt: Canvas. One landscape crossing three mediums in a single image: rolling hills that begin as loose pencil construction lines, resolve into inked linework midfield, and finish as full oil paint at the far ridge - the same scene becoming more painted as it goes.
C.alt: One landscape shifting from pencil to ink to oil paint.
C.bio: The same hills can be graphite, ink, or oil. Canvas is the medium the image pretends to be - and commits to.

T.prompt: Tone. One orchard lane split down its middle seam: the left half in warm honeyed golds, the right half in cold blue dusk, identical trees wearing two entirely different moods - palette as attitude.
T.alt: An orchard lane split between warm gold and cold blue.
T.bio: Identical trees, two moods. Tone is the palette's attitude doing the emotional work before the subject says a word.

U.prompt: Universe. A single wooden door standing alone in quiet grassland, opened onto a rain-soaked neon city at night, a small traveler on the threshold between the two worlds.
U.alt: A lone door in grassland opening onto a neon city.
U.bio: A door in a field, a city in the door. Universe decides what world is standing around your subject.

R.prompt: References. An artist's desk from above, strewn with open books, postcards, and torn print clippings of wildly different painting styles, a hand mid-stroke copying from one onto a fresh sheet - a study built from studies. All book pages and clippings show artwork only, no readable writing.
R.alt: A desk of art studies with a hand copying from them.
R.bio: Studies of studies. References name the shoulders an image stands on - artists, movements, and looks worth channeling.

E.prompt: Execution. Two hands raised against a wide sunset valley making the director's framing gesture, thumbs and forefingers boxing the horizon, the land inside the finger-frame subtly sharper and more finished than the loose world outside it.
E.alt: Hands framing a sunset valley with the director's gesture.
E.bio: The finger-frame at the end: crop, finish, and polish. Execution is every decision that turns a scene into a shot.

lone-wanderer.prompt: A lone cloaked wanderer seen from behind on an empty road winding through open moorland, walking stick in hand, the road narrowing toward a pale horizon, no other soul in sight.
lone-wanderer.alt: A cloaked wanderer on an empty winding road
lone-wanderer.bio: Every road needs someone to mean it. Put one figure on an empty mile and the picture stops being scenery and starts being a question.

gentle-giant.prompt: A moss-covered gentle giant creature kneeling in a meadow to look at a tiny human figure standing unafraid before it, wildflowers bending in the creature's warm breath.
gentle-giant.alt: A moss-covered giant creature beside a small figure
gentle-giant.bio: Bigness without threat. A giant that kneels teaches scale better than any ruler - the meadow, the clouds, and you all agree on how small you are.

golden-hour.prompt: A lone oak on a grassy hillside at golden hour, low amber sunlight raking across the slope, the tree's long shadow reaching toward the viewer, warm haze softening the far fields.
golden-hour.alt: A lone tree on a hillside in low golden sunlight
golden-hour.bio: The forgiving hour. It lays gold on ordinary grass, stretches every shadow into a story, and makes even a lone tree look like it was placed there on purpose.

bioluminescence.prompt: A dark tidal cove at night where glowing blue-green plankton trace every ripple, a rowboat drifting through the luminous water, mushrooms and moss along the rocks giving off their own soft living light.
bioluminescence.alt: Glowing organisms lighting a dark cove
bioluminescence.bio: Light that is alive and knows it. It gathers where the water moves, spends itself in ripples, and turns the dark into something breathing.

candlelight.prompt: An old wooden table where a hooded reader leans over an open book, lit by warm flickering candlelight, deep soft shadows swallowing the room beyond the small circle of flame.
candlelight.alt: A reader at a table lit by candle flame
candlelight.bio: One small fire against the whole of the dark. It cannot light a room, so it chooses a face instead, and the room agrees to disappear.

moonlight.prompt: A sleeping farmhouse and frost-touched field bathed in cold blue moonlight, the moon high and small, tin roof and fence wire glinting silver, night shadows soft and long.
moonlight.alt: A silvered field and farmhouse under the moon
moonlight.bio: The sun's cold echo. It owns every color it touches, pays in silver, and keeps the world quiet while it counts.

neon-glow.prompt: A late-night noodle stall on a wet street lit entirely by buzzing neon signs, magenta and cyan glow washing the steam and the cook's apron, colored reflections doubled in the puddles.
neon-glow.alt: A noodle stall drenched in neon signage light
neon-glow.bio: Light with an agenda. It doesn't illuminate a scene so much as advertise it, and everything it touches becomes part of the sign.

harsh-noon.prompt: A whitewashed courtyard at high noon, hard overhead sun cutting knife-black shadows under the arches, a single figure with a wide hat crossing the glare, heat visible in the air.
harsh-noon.alt: A white courtyard under hard overhead sun
harsh-noon.bio: The honest interrogation. No flattering angle, no soft edge - just what a thing is, printed in black directly beneath it.

overcast-soft.prompt: A small fishing harbor under a flat gray sky, shadowless diffuse light evening out the boats and stacked crates, colors quiet and true, the water pewter-smooth.
overcast-soft.alt: A gray-day harbor in shadowless light
overcast-soft.bio: The world's biggest softbox. It flatters nothing and punishes nothing - it just tells the truth gently, everywhere at once.

dramatic-rim.prompt: A boxer standing in a dark gym, a hard rim light from behind drawing a bright edge along their shoulders, arms, and jaw, the face nearly lost in shadow, sweat glinting on the lit line.
dramatic-rim.alt: A boxer edged in rim light against darkness
dramatic-rim.bio: Light that refuses to enter. It walks the border of a thing instead, and the border turns out to be enough.

volumetric-rays.prompt: An old barn interior where volumetric god rays pour through gaps in the boards, dust swimming visibly in the shafts, a plow horse standing where the brightest beam lands.
volumetric-rays.alt: Dusty light shafts crossing a barn interior
volumetric-rays.bio: Light made visible by what floats in it. Give the air a little dust and every sunbeam confesses its geometry.

firelight.prompt: Three travelers around a campfire at night, dancing orange firelight playing over their faces and hands, sparks rising, shadows leaping and shrinking on the rocks behind them.
firelight.alt: Faces around a campfire in dancing orange light
firelight.bio: The only light that moves on its own. It never holds still long enough to be trusted, which is exactly why every story starts beside it.

storm-light.prompt: A lighthouse on a black headland under a charged storm sky, a lightning flash freezing the rain in mid-air, waves caught white against the rocks, the whole scene lit for one violent instant.
storm-light.alt: A lighthouse under a lightning-lit storm sky
storm-light.bio: A flashbulb the size of the sky. It shoots one frame per storm and never asks anyone to hold still.

studio-softbox.prompt: A single ceramic vase on a seamless gray backdrop in crisp softbox studio light, gradients smooth and deliberate, one soft reflection, nothing in the frame by accident.
studio-softbox.alt: A ceramic vase in clean seamless studio light
studio-softbox.bio: Light with the wildness bred out of it. Nothing here is found - every gradient was negotiated, and the shadow signed a contract.

oil-painting.prompt: A single pear on a sunlit windowsill rendered as an expressive oil painting, confident visible brushstrokes carrying the fruit's curve, pigment texture alive in the light.
oil-painting.alt: A pear on a windowsill painted in oils
oil-painting.bio: Paint that remembers the hand. Oil holds every decision the brush made, wet against wet, and never pretends the picture arrived by itself.

watercolor.prompt: A red umbrella crossing a rainy street rendered as loose watercolor, pigment blooming at every wet edge, puddle reflections bleeding into soft paper white.
watercolor.alt: A rainy street umbrella scene in watercolor
watercolor.bio: Controlled flooding. Watercolor is the only medium you negotiate with - you steer the water, the water decides, and the best parts are its idea.

pencil-sketch.prompt: A sleeping cat curled on a chair drawn as a graphite pencil sketch, visible construction lines beneath the fur, shading built from patient hatching.
pencil-sketch.alt: A sleeping cat drawn in graphite pencil
pencil-sketch.bio: Thinking you can watch. A pencil sketch leaves its scaffolding standing - every guess, correction, and change of mind still on the page.

ink-illustration.prompt: A strutting rooster as a pen-and-ink illustration, crosshatched shading building the body from pure line, every feather a decision in black on white.
ink-illustration.alt: A rooster drawn in crosshatched pen and ink
ink-illustration.bio: No gray allowed. Ink commits - every tone must be earned by lines willing to cross each other, and every white is a decision not to touch.

charcoal-drawing.prompt: A draft horse standing in wind rendered as a smudged charcoal drawing, deep soft blacks in the mane, tone dragged with the thumb, dust of the medium still on the page.
charcoal-drawing.alt: A draft horse rendered in smudged charcoal
charcoal-drawing.bio: Burnt wood and nerve. Charcoal smears, lifts, and shatters - the drawing stays alive because the medium never quite agrees to be finished.

gouache-poster.prompt: A lighthouse over a cove as a mid-century gouache poster, matte flat shapes locking together, simplified waves in three confident blues, paper grain in every flat.
gouache-poster.alt: A lighthouse cove as a mid-century gouache poster
gouache-poster.bio: Confidence in flats. Gouache dries matte and final - no glazing your way out - so every shape has to be right the first time.

pixel-art.prompt: A tiny cottage at dusk with a lit window rendered as detailed 16-bit pixel art, every pixel placed on purpose, smoke rising one square at a time.
pixel-art.alt: A tiny cottage rendered in pixel art
pixel-art.bio: Art by rationing. Give an image only so many squares and every one becomes a choice - nostalgia is just economy you can see.

low-poly-3d.prompt: A standing stag as a low-poly 3d render, its body faceted into clean triangles, flat-shaded planes catching a cool gradient sky.
low-poly-3d.alt: A stag rendered as faceted low-poly 3d
low-poly-3d.bio: How few faces make a face? Low-poly is sculpture by subtraction - keep deleting triangles until only the animal's idea is left.

clay-render.prompt: A cheerful snail with a spiral shell as a playful claymation-style render, soft studio light on plasticine, tool marks and gentle fingerprints in the surface.
clay-render.alt: A cheerful snail sculpted in clay
clay-render.bio: The friendliest material. Clay keeps your fingerprints as proof that somebody played - a render you want to pick up and squish.

film-photograph.prompt: A roadside diner at dusk as a 35mm film photograph, natural grain across the sky, honest optics, the neonless building glowing softly against real evening.
film-photograph.alt: A roadside diner shot on 35mm film
film-photograph.bio: Chemistry as witness. Film grain isn't noise - it's the physical texture of the moment having actually happened somewhere.

papercut-collage.prompt: A whale diving through layered waves as a papercut collage, each depth a separate sheet of colored paper, crisp real drop shadows between the layers.
papercut-collage.alt: A layered papercut collage of a whale
papercut-collage.bio: Depth you could reach into. Paper earns its shadows honestly - every layer is a real millimeter, and the knife did all the drawing.

stained-glass.prompt: A kingfisher over water as a stained-glass window, leaded black outlines holding panes of luminous blue and amber glass, light doing the coloring from behind.
stained-glass.alt: A kingfisher rendered as a stained-glass window
stained-glass.bio: A drawing the sun finishes. The lead holds the shapes; the light shows up every morning to color them in again.

embroidered-textile.prompt: A sitting fox as embroidered textile art, visible satin and chain stitches building the fur direction, linen ground showing between threads, hand-warm and slightly imperfect.
embroidered-textile.alt: A fox stitched in embroidered thread
embroidered-textile.bio: An image at a stitch per second. Embroidery spends hours where other media spend strokes - the slowness is visible, and it reads as love.

comic-ink-flats.prompt: A courier leaping a rooftop gap drawn as a single comic panel, bold ink outlines and flat color, the city dropping away below in confident blacks.
comic-ink-flats.alt: A rooftop leap drawn as a comic panel
comic-ink-flats.bio: Line does the acting. Comics flatten color so the ink can move - one confident outline is worth a hundred rendered muscles.

muted-palette.prompt: A quiet fishing village at dawn in a muted desaturated palette, grays and softened blues carrying the forms, value structure doing the work color declines to do.
muted-palette.alt: A quiet fishing village in muted desaturated color
muted-palette.bio: Color speaking under its breath. Mute the palette and the values step forward - the picture gets quieter and somehow easier to hear.

neon-saturation.prompt: A narrow arcade alley at night in a saturated neon palette, glowing magenta and cyan flooding wet pavement, color pushed past realism into pure signal.
neon-saturation.alt: An arcade alley in saturated neon color
neon-saturation.bio: Color as voltage. Past a certain saturation the palette stops describing things and starts broadcasting - realism traded for pure signal.

pastel-dream.prompt: Hot-air balloons drifting over misty hills in a soft dreamy pastel palette, powdered pinks, mints, and lilacs, nothing in the scene allowed to shout.
pastel-dream.alt: A hot-air balloon morning in soft pastels
pastel-dream.bio: The volume knob turned toward kindness. Pastels promise that nothing in the picture will hurt you - and keep the promise.

monochrome-noir.prompt: A rain-slick exterior stairwell at night in true black-and-white noir, deep contrast, a fedora-shadowed figure paused under one hard bulb, blinds striping the wall.
monochrome-noir.alt: A rain-slick stairwell in black-and-white noir
monochrome-noir.bio: Subtract color, inherit mood. Noir proves the palette was optional all along - shadow and one hard light can carry the entire story.

earthy-naturals.prompt: A stone barn with stacked pumpkins and hay in an earthy palette of ochre, moss, and umber, colors that all came out of the same ground.
earthy-naturals.alt: A harvest barn scene in ochre, moss, and umber
earthy-naturals.bio: Colors with fingerprints of the ground on them. Nothing synthetic, nothing borrowed - a palette you could dig up with a spade.

jewel-tones.prompt: A bazaar textile stall stacked with silks in rich jewel tones - emerald, sapphire, and ruby glowing deep under lantern light, saturated but never neon.
jewel-tones.alt: A bazaar textile stall in emerald, sapphire, and ruby
jewel-tones.bio: Depth instead of glow. Jewel tones saturate downward - richer, darker, heavier - luxury measured in how far the color goes in.

sepia-vintage.prompt: An old fairground carousel aged into sepia tones, warm brown chemistry over every horse and mirror, a photograph that has spent decades in a drawer.
sepia-vintage.alt: A carousel photograph aged to sepia
sepia-vintage.bio: Time as a pigment. Sepia is what memory does to color - keeps the warmth, files off the specifics, and calls it truth.

iridescent-shift.prompt: A jewel beetle on a wet leaf in iridescent oil-slick color, its shell shifting green-violet-gold with the angle, rainbow interference sliding across every curve.
iridescent-shift.alt: A beetle on a leaf in oil-slick iridescent color
iridescent-shift.bio: Color that won't hold still. Iridescence lives between you and the surface - tilt your head and the palette repaints itself.

high-contrast.prompt: A chess set by a window in high contrast, hard highlights against deep shadows, half of every piece blazing and half gone black, the board split like the game.
high-contrast.alt: A chess set split by hard light and shadow
high-contrast.bio: No diplomacy between light and dark. Contrast deletes the middle ground until every edge becomes a decision.

candy-pop.prompt: An ice-cream van on a sunny street in a glossy candy-pop palette, bubblegum pink and lemon yellow, every surface enameled and cheerful past reason.
candy-pop.alt: An ice-cream van in glossy candy colors
candy-pop.bio: Serotonin as a palette. Candy color doesn't describe the world - it frosts it, and dares you not to smile.

cold-steel.prompt: A shipyard crane over gray water in a cold steel palette, slate blues and gunmetal grays, industrial color with all the warmth machined off.
cold-steel.alt: A shipyard crane in steel blues and gunmetal
cold-steel.bio: The temperature of machinery. Steel blues keep their distance - a palette that respects you without once being friendly.

sun-bleached.prompt: An old boardwalk fence and beach signage in a sun-bleached palette, colors faded like decade-old paint, whites gone bone, reds surviving as rumors.
sun-bleached.alt: A boardwalk fence faded by years of sun
sun-bleached.bio: What the sun leaves behind. Bleached color is history you can read - every faded plank an honest record of ten thousand noons.

rainswept-city.prompt: A rain-swept night city where a figure with an umbrella waits at a crossing, streets turned to mirrors, every window and signal doubled in the wet asphalt.
rainswept-city.alt: A night city under steady rain, streets mirrored
rainswept-city.bio: A city that got a second copy of itself. Rain turns every dull street into a mirror and every light into two.

ancient-forest.prompt: Deep in an ancient mossy forest where a deer path bends between colossal trunks, shafts of green-gold light between the trees, ferns waist-high, silence with texture.
ancient-forest.alt: Deep mossy old-growth woods with light shafts
ancient-forest.bio: Time measured in moss. The old woods keep their own light, their own weather, and their own opinion of visitors.

desert-expanse.prompt: A vast desert of rolling dunes with a tiny camel caravan cresting one ridge, wind-carved sand ripples in the foreground, heat softening the far horizon.
desert-expanse.alt: Rolling dunes to the horizon with one caravan
desert-expanse.bio: Emptiness with excellent posture. The desert deletes everything optional and keeps only light, distance, and whoever insists on crossing.

frozen-tundra.prompt: A frozen tundra of deep snow and blue-shadowed ice where a sled team pushes toward a low sun, breath-fog hanging, the cold visible in every color.
frozen-tundra.alt: Deep snow and ice fields with a lone sled team
frozen-tundra.bio: Cold as a landlord. The tundra charges for every mile and pays out in a silence you can hear your heartbeat inside.

underwater-depths.prompt: Deep underwater where a lone diver hangs in open blue, light shafts angling down from a distant surface, particles drifting, a whale shape far below in the dark blue.
underwater-depths.alt: Open blue water with a diver and drifting light
underwater-depths.bio: Gravity resigns; blue takes over. Underwater every direction is a suggestion and the light arrives already tired.

mountain-heights.prompt: High jagged mountain country where a climber traverses a spine of rock, valleys drowned in cloud below, thin air sharpening every edge of stone.
mountain-heights.alt: Jagged peaks and thin air with a small climber
mountain-heights.bio: Geography with an ego. Mountains rearrange the sky, bully the weather, and make everything humans build look temporary.

cozy-interior.prompt: A cozy cluttered interior where a cat sleeps in an armchair among blankets, plants, and mug-crowded shelves, lamplight warm, rain safely on the far side of the window.
cozy-interior.alt: A warm cluttered room with blankets and plants
cozy-interior.bio: Architecture at blanket scale. A cozy room is a place that has decided the weather outside is somebody else's problem.

grand-library.prompt: A grand vaulted library where a small reader stands at a table beneath tiers of galleries and rolling ladders, shelves rising into arched shadow, dust idling in the window light.
grand-library.alt: A vaulted library of ladders and galleries
grand-library.bio: Knowledge with a skyline. A great library is a city where every citizen is a book and silence is the traffic.

floating-islands.prompt: Grassy islands hanging in open sky with waterfalls pouring off their edges into cloud, a rope bridge linking two of them, a small traveler midway across.
floating-islands.alt: Grassy islands hanging in open sky
floating-islands.bio: Ground that gave notice. Float the land and every waterfall becomes a question the sky has to answer.

cyberpunk-megacity.prompt: A cyberpunk megacity of layered towers and elevated trains where a street vendor's cart glows at the base of hundred-story walls, holographic koi swimming between buildings.
cyberpunk-megacity.alt: Layered towers, holograms, and wet streets
cyberpunk-megacity.bio: A city that forgot how to stop. It stacked streets on streets until 'up' became a district and the ground became a legend.

medieval-village.prompt: A medieval village of thatch and timber around a market square, geese scattering past a well, smoke rising from crooked chimneys, cart ruts worn deep in the lane.
medieval-village.alt: Thatch and timber village with a market square
medieval-village.bio: The centuries with the volume up. Thatch, timber, and mud arranging themselves into a postcard nobody sent yet.

space-frontier.prompt: The space frontier: a ring station turning over a curving planet, tug ships crossing its lit docks, deep starfield behind, one small EVA figure on the hull.
space-frontier.alt: Stations and starships against deep space
space-frontier.bio: The neighborhood after the sky. Space grants infinite room and charges exactly one atmosphere for it.

victorian-streets.prompt: Foggy Victorian streets of iron and brick where a lamplighter raises his pole to a gas lamp, carriage lanterns floating in the murk, wet cobbles catching each new flame.
victorian-streets.alt: Foggy gaslit streets of iron and brick
victorian-streets.bio: A city wearing its weather indoors. Gaslight and fog negotiate every evening, and the fog usually wins by morning.

tropical-shore.prompt: A tropical shore of turquoise water and leaning palms where a beached outrigger canoe rests on white sand, reef shadows patterning the shallows.
tropical-shore.bio: Paradise runs on two pigments. Turquoise and palm-green split the world between them and let the sand keep the change.

art-nouveau.prompt: A woman with long flowing hair among climbing wisteria, rendered in art nouveau style - sinuous organic linework, ornamental curves, hair and vine sharing one rhythm.
art-nouveau.alt: A woman with flowing hair in art nouveau linework
art-nouveau.bio: The line that refuses corners. Nouveau lets hair, smoke, and stems all speak the same curving language until ornament becomes structure.

ukiyo-e.prompt: A ferryboat crossing beneath a rising wave in ukiyo-e woodblock style, flat confident color planes, clean printed line, a distant snow peak holding the horizon.
ukiyo-e.alt: A wave and ferryboat as a woodblock print
ukiyo-e.bio: The floating world, four colors at a time. Ukiyo-e proves an ocean fits in flat planes if every line knows its job.

impressionist-brush.prompt: A garden luncheon under dappled shade in impressionist style, broken color and visible daubs, sunlight arriving as separate touches of paint that mix in the eye.
impressionist-brush.alt: A garden luncheon in broken impressionist color
impressionist-brush.bio: Light caught mid-sentence. The impressionists painted fast because the sun would not hold the pose.

baroque-drama.prompt: A candlelit gathering around a table in dramatic baroque style, deep chiaroscuro, faces blazing out of darkness, one raised hand caught in theatrical light.
baroque-drama.alt: A candlelit gathering in deep chiaroscuro
baroque-drama.bio: Lighting as theology. The baroque decided shadow was a stage curtain and light an argument you could win.

surrealist-dream.prompt: A freestanding doorway open in an empty field in surrealist style, dream logic in charge - clouds passing through the door to a different sky, a key floating at eye height.
surrealist-dream.alt: A doorway standing open in an impossible field
surrealist-dream.bio: Logic on sabbatical. Surrealism keeps the rendering honest so the impossibility lands - you believe the door precisely because the grass is real.

gothic-romance.prompt: A figure in a long dress at the window of a ruined abbey in gothic romance style, ivy and lace, beautiful melancholy, moonlight through broken tracery.
gothic-romance.alt: A ruined abbey in moonlit gothic melancholy
gothic-romance.bio: Sorrow, but make it architecture. The gothic keeps its broken hearts in broken buildings so the weather can grieve along.

art-deco-geometry.prompt: A grand hotel entrance in art deco style, gilded geometry and fanned sunburst motifs, stepped forms in gold and black, a doorman dwarfed by streamlined splendor.
art-deco-geometry.alt: A grand hotel entrance in gilded deco geometry
art-deco-geometry.bio: Optimism, machined and gilded. Deco believed the future would arrive by elevator, and dressed the lobby for it.

renaissance-fresco.prompt: Robed figures gathered beneath an arch as a renaissance fresco, drapery studied and serene, pigment sunk into aged plaster, hairline cracks crossing a calm sky.
renaissance-fresco.alt: Figures and drapery on an aged fresco wall
renaissance-fresco.bio: Paint married to the wall. A fresco sets in an afternoon and stays five centuries - conviction measured in wet plaster.

van-gogh-swirl.prompt: A cypress tree under a night sky in the style of van gogh, thick swirling impasto strokes, stars spun into vortices, the ground rolling in painted waves.
van-gogh-swirl.alt: A cypress and night sky in swirling impasto
van-gogh-swirl.bio: Weather systems made of paint. He didn't render the night - he reported its currents, and the currents were true.

anime-cel.prompt: A student leaning on a school rooftop railing in anime cel style, clean linework and flat shading, wind in the hair, a painted cumulus sky behind.
anime-cel.alt: A student on a rooftop in anime cel shading
anime-cel.bio: Feeling at 24 frames of clarity. Cel shading strips light to two decisions so the eyes can carry everything else.

cinematic-still.prompt: Two figures across a diner booth as a cinematic film still, anamorphic framing, shallow focus, motivated window light, a story visibly paused mid-beat.
cinematic-still.alt: A tense diner scene graded like a film frame
cinematic-still.bio: One frame owing a whole movie. Grade, blocking, and focus conspire until a paused image starts playing itself.

concept-art-sheet.prompt: A moss-grown guardian golem rendered as polished production concept art, confident design language, material callouts implied by finish, a hero pose against clean atmosphere.
concept-art-sheet.alt: A guardian golem as production concept art
concept-art-sheet.bio: Drawing as decision-making. Concept art exists to answer questions - what it's made of, how it moves, why it matters - beautifully.

vaporwave-grid.prompt: A marble bust and potted palm on a pink-and-teal wireframe grid in vaporwave style, checkerboard floor to a low sun, early-web haze over everything.
vaporwave-grid.alt: A marble bust and palms on a wireframe grid
vaporwave-grid.bio: Nostalgia for a place that never existed. Vaporwave decorates the afterlife of dead software in marble and sunset.

cottagecore-idyll.prompt: A cottage garden table in cottagecore style - fresh bread and wildflowers on gingham, bees at the lavender, laundry line catching a honeyed breeze.
cottagecore-idyll.alt: A cottage garden idyll with gingham and bread
cottagecore-idyll.bio: The pastoral dream with the wifi hidden. Cottagecore is a promise that somewhere the bread is warm and the bees are employed.

dark-fantasy-grim.prompt: A hooded pilgrim before an iron shrine in dark fantasy style - bone charms, guttering torchlight, chains and crow feathers, dread as part of the architecture.
dark-fantasy-grim.alt: An iron shrine in torchlit grimdark
dark-fantasy-grim.bio: Fantasy with the warranty expired. Grimdark keeps the dragons and cancels the rescue - atmosphere you have to survive.

synthwave-sunset.prompt: A chrome sports car on an endless highway toward a striped synthwave sunset, neon grid horizon, palm silhouettes strobing past, the eighties future at full speed.
synthwave-sunset.alt: A chrome car driving into a striped sunset
synthwave-sunset.bio: A decade's daydream at 120mph. Synthwave drives toward a sun made of stripes and never wants to arrive.

childrens-book-charm.prompt: A round bear in a red scarf carrying an umbrella as a warm children's storybook illustration, friendly wobbly linework, soft flat color, rain drawn as kind little dashes.
childrens-book-charm.alt: A bear in a scarf as a storybook page
childrens-book-charm.bio: Drawn to be read aloud. The wobble in the line is on purpose - it is the visual voice of once upon a time.

tarot-card-mystic.prompt: A robed figure holding a lantern composed like a tarot arcana - centered and frontal, sun and moon in opposite corners, symbolic objects arranged with ritual balance.
tarot-card-mystic.alt: A centered arcana figure with celestial symbols
tarot-card-mystic.bio: A picture that expects to be read. The arcana arranges its symbols like a sentence and lets you supply the fortune.

vintage-travel-poster.prompt: A clifftop coastal village as a vintage travel poster, flat optimistic shapes, simplified sea and sun, the view selling itself in confident holiday color.
vintage-travel-poster.alt: A coastal village as a vintage travel poster
vintage-travel-poster.bio: Geography with a sales team. The travel poster simplifies a place into the version of itself you would buy a ticket for.

botanical-plate.prompt: A flowering nightshade studied as a botanical scientific illustration on cream paper - precise stems, dissected blossom parts arranged beside the plant, naturalist exactness.
botanical-plate.alt: A studied plant specimen on cream paper
botanical-plate.bio: Reverence disguised as taxonomy. The botanical plate looks at one plant harder than most pictures look at anything.

close-portrait.prompt: An intimate close-up portrait of a freckled sailor, weathered face filling most of the frame, eyes sharp, the harbor behind melted to soft color by shallow depth of field.
close-portrait.alt: An intimate close-up portrait, background melted
close-portrait.bio: Distance deleted. The close portrait spends the entire frame on one face and dares it to keep a secret.

wide-establishing.prompt: A wide establishing shot of a river valley at dawn - a small monastery on a bend, fields stitched to the far hills, one road finding its way through the geography.
wide-establishing.alt: A sweeping wide vista establishing the scene
wide-establishing.bio: The sentence before the story. A wide shot tells you where everything is so every later frame knows what it's leaving out.

low-angle-hero.prompt: A firefighter stepping from smoke shot from near the ground, low-angle hero framing, boots huge in the foreground, the figure monumental against a churning sky.
low-angle-hero.alt: A hero shot looking up from near the ground
low-angle-hero.bio: Respect is an angle. Drop the camera to the ground and anyone standing becomes architecture.

birds-eye-view.prompt: A street market seen straight down from above, bird's-eye view flattening stalls, awnings, and shoppers into a living pattern of color and motion.
birds-eye-view.alt: A market scene seen straight down from above
birds-eye-view.bio: The view that turns life into pattern. Straight down, a crowd becomes weather and a street becomes a diagram of itself.

dutch-tilt.prompt: A courier sprinting through an alley with the whole frame on a dutch tilt, horizon tipped hard, walls leaning into the run, urgency built from angle alone.
dutch-tilt.alt: A chase moment with the horizon tipped
dutch-tilt.bio: Unease by rotation. Tip the horizon and the viewer's inner ear joins the cast.

symmetric-center.prompt: A grand hotel corridor in perfectly symmetrical centered composition, chandeliers receding in matched pairs, a single bellhop dead center where the mirror lines meet.
symmetric-center.alt: A grand hall in perfect mirror symmetry
symmetric-center.bio: Order announced out loud. Central symmetry is composition standing at attention - calm to some eyes, ominous to others, deliberate to all.

rule-of-thirds.prompt: A small red boat placed on the lower-left third of a wide calm sea, rule-of-thirds composition, open negative space carrying the morning light.
rule-of-thirds.alt: A small boat placed off-center in open water
rule-of-thirds.bio: The grid nobody sees and everybody feels. Thirds give a subject somewhere to look toward - and the picture room to answer.

shallow-bokeh.prompt: A barista's hands pouring latte art in shallow depth of field, the cup razor-sharp while the cafe behind melts into creamy bokeh circles of window light.
shallow-bokeh.alt: A subject isolated by creamy background bokeh
shallow-bokeh.bio: Attention rendered optically. Bokeh is the lens agreeing to forget everything except the one thing you meant.

long-exposure.prompt: A stone bridge over a waterfall at dusk in long exposure, the water silked to mist, car lights drawing unbroken ribbons across the span, the stones perfectly still.
long-exposure.alt: Silked water and light trails over time
long-exposure.bio: The camera holding its breath. A long exposure lets time pile up in one frame until motion becomes material.

double-exposure.prompt: A double exposure blending a woman's profile with a pine forest, the treeline rising through her silhouette, birds crossing where her thoughts would be.
double-exposure.alt: A profile blended with a forest in one frame
double-exposure.bio: Two truths, one frame. The double exposure lets a person contain a landscape and calls the overlap honesty.

silhouette-shot.prompt: A fisherman casting from a jetty as a clean black silhouette against a blazing sunset sky, all detail surrendered to one perfect readable shape.
silhouette-shot.alt: A clean black silhouette against bright light
silhouette-shot.bio: Identity by outline. The silhouette deletes every detail and keeps only the shape - which turns out to be the part you recognize.

motion-blur-action.prompt: A cyclist sprinting through a city in a panned action shot, rider sharp while the street streaks past in horizontal motion blur, speed printed on the frame.
motion-blur-action.alt: A sprinting cyclist with the world streaking past
motion-blur-action.bio: Speed you can develop. Motion blur is the frame confessing it couldn't hold still either.

isometric-view.prompt: A corner bakery rendered in isometric view, parallel projection with no vanishing point, the little building crisp as a game tile, its alley and rooftop equally knowable.
isometric-view.alt: A tidy isometric miniature of a scene
isometric-view.bio: Perspective, off the clock. Isometric space never converges - the world becomes a toy you understand completely.

knolling-flatlay.prompt: A ranger's field kit knolled on canvas from above - knife, compass, matches, rope, and rations aligned at strict right angles, an inventory turned into composition.
knolling-flatlay.alt: Objects arranged at right angles from above
knolling-flatlay.bio: Tidiness as portraiture. Knolling lays a life out at right angles and lets the objects testify.

hyper-detailed.prompt: A tide pool rendered hyper-detailed - every barnacle, bubble, and grain resolved, intricate texture rewarding the closest look, the frame dense with observed life.
hyper-detailed.alt: A scene engraved with obsessive miniature detail
hyper-detailed.bio: Generosity by the square inch. Hyper-detail promises that anywhere you look, the picture already looked harder.

minimalist-negative-space.prompt: A single red kite high in a vast pale sky, minimalist composition, the tiny diamond and its string the only marks in an ocean of negative space.
minimalist-negative-space.alt: A tiny subject in a vast clean field
minimalist-negative-space.bio: The art of what you leave out. Negative space isn't empty - it's the frame holding its breath around one small thing.

faithful-companion.prompt: A traveler crouched at a trailside fire with a loyal dog pressed against their side, both looking out at the same distant hills, two silhouettes sharing one warmth.
faithful-companion.alt: A traveler with an animal companion at their side
faithful-companion.bio: One figure is lonely; two is a story. The companion's job is simple - stand close enough that the picture reads as us instead of me.

clockwork-automaton.prompt: An intricate brass clockwork automaton seated at a workbench threading a needle, escapements ticking behind its glass chest panel, lamplight warm on its polished shoulders.
clockwork-automaton.alt: A brass clockwork figure with visible gears
clockwork-automaton.bio: Wind it and it wonders. The automaton earns its place by doing something tender with mechanical hands - the gears are the body, the task is the soul.

armored-sentinel.prompt: An armored sentinel in full battered plate standing watch at a mountain pass gate, spear grounded, snow settling on the pauldrons, unmoved and unmovable.
armored-sentinel.bio: Armor is a promise worn on the outside. The sentinel stands so the picture can ask what's worth standing for.

wise-elder.prompt: A wise elder with deep lines and knowing eyes mending a fishing net on a stone step, silver hair loose in the wind, hands that have done this ten thousand times.
wise-elder.alt: A deeply lined elder with knowing eyes
wise-elder.bio: Time drawn on a face. Every line is a sentence the years wrote; the elder lets a picture carry a whole life without telling any of it.

spirited-child.prompt: A spirited child in a too-big coat marching ahead up a forest path, stick raised like a sword, chin up, absolutely certain of a destination no adult can see.
spirited-child.alt: An adventurous child leading the way
spirited-child.bio: Courage before scale, wonder before sense. Put a child in front and the picture points forward all by itself.

winged-beast.prompt: A great winged beast perched on a sea cliff with wings half-spread against the wind, feathers and scale catching the light, head turned toward the open water.
winged-beast.alt: A great winged beast with outstretched wings
winged-beast.bio: The sky needs an owner. Wings at the right size are weather; the beast decides how much of the picture belongs to the air.

ghostly-presence.prompt: A ghostly spectral figure drifting across an abandoned ballroom, translucent as breath on glass, moonlight passing straight through the hem of its dress onto the dusty floor.
ghostly-presence.alt: A translucent spectral figure in the scene
ghostly-presence.bio: Presence at half opacity. A ghost is the picture admitting that someone used to be here - and deciding not to let go of it.

crowd-of-many.prompt: A flower seller with a bright cart surrounded by a bustling market crowd, faces and shoulders streaming past on every side, the seller a still point in the current.
crowd-of-many.alt: A subject surrounded by a bustling crowd
crowd-of-many.bio: One face, then arithmetic. A crowd is scale made of people - and whoever holds still in it becomes the subject for free.

regal-figure.prompt: A regal crowned figure in deep ceremonial robes descending a hall of columns, train pouring down the steps behind, attendants' shadows kneeling at the edges.
regal-figure.alt: A crowned figure in ceremonial robes
regal-figure.bio: Rank you can draw. Ceremony piles itself on a person until the picture has to decide which one it is portraying.

weathered-explorer.prompt: A weathered explorer pausing at a canyon rim with a battered pack, rolled maps, and sun-bleached scarf, boots gray with a thousand miles, eyes on the far side.
weathered-explorer.alt: A journey-worn explorer with expedition gear
weathered-explorer.bio: The journey, worn as clothing. Every scuff is a mile that actually happened; the explorer lets the picture claim distance without drawing it.

storybook-cover.prompt: A small cloaked figure stepping into a vast golden ancient forest, painted in loose watercolor with flowing art nouveau linework, golden-hour light shafting between mossy trunks, a wide establishing frame - a wistful storybook cover moment.
storybook-cover.alt: A watercolor figure entering a golden ancient forest
storybook-cover.bio: The cover that promises the whole journey: gold light, old trees, and a figure exactly small enough to root for.

neon-noir.prompt: A tight close-up portrait of a rain-soaked figure in a night city, saturated neon magenta and cyan flooding the wet streets behind, faint bioluminescent glow tracing the puddles, shallow focus - electric noir at full charge.
neon-noir.bio: One face, one storm of signal. The city does the lighting and the rain signs the print.

epic-fantasy-cover.prompt: A lone armored figure on a crag shot from near the ground looking up, storm light flashing behind, dark-fantasy iron and bone against rich jewel tones, baroque chiaroscuro carving the figure out of the tempest - a wide epic book-cover frame.
epic-fantasy-cover.alt: A storm-lit grimdark hero from below
epic-fantasy-cover.bio: Thunder, iron, and jewel-deep color. The cover for a book heavy enough to prop a door.

cozy-storybook.prompt: A warm cluttered reading nook painted in soft watercolor with friendly children's-book charm, pastel pinks and mints, gray-day light through the window, blankets and plants and a sleeping cat - a picture-book page you can nap inside.
cozy-storybook.alt: A soft pastel watercolor picture-book room
cozy-storybook.bio: Gray light outside, pastel warmth inside. A page built for reading aloud at whisper volume.

cyber-portrait.prompt: A tight cinematic close-up of a face lit by buzzing neon signs, cyberpunk megacity towers layered behind, hard high-contrast grade splitting the features between magenta glow and black shadow - a film still from a future that never sleeps.
cyber-portrait.alt: A neon-lit face in a megacity, hard contrast
cyber-portrait.bio: The city writes its signs on the nearest face. High contrast keeps only what the neon insists on.

studio-product.prompt: A single beautiful object dead center on a seamless backdrop in crisp softbox studio light, generous minimalist negative space around it, honest 35mm film grain - a commercial frame with nothing accidental in it.
studio-product.alt: A clean centered studio shot with film texture
studio-product.bio: Silence, symmetry, softbox. The product shot where even the shadow was hired.

ghost-story.prompt: A translucent spectral figure drifting down a foggy gaslit Victorian street, cold moonlight through the murk, black-and-white noir palette with gothic romance ruin and lace - a haunting in silver and soot.
ghost-story.alt: A spectral figure in moonlit Victorian fog
ghost-story.bio: Silver light, black iron, and someone who never left. The fog does the rest.

plein-air.prompt: A wide golden-hour field with a distant easel and painter, rendered in broken impressionist color over earthy ochres and mosses, daubs of warm light mixing in the eye - an afternoon painted before it could get away.
plein-air.alt: A golden field in broken impressionist color
plein-air.bio: Chasing the light on location. The field, the hour, and the paint all wet at once.

retro-sprite.prompt: A small heroic figure seen from a low angle, rendered as detailed 16-bit pixel art in a loud candy-pop palette, deep-space starfield and planets behind - a title-screen hero frame from a cartridge that never existed.
retro-sprite.alt: A candy-colored pixel hero against deep space
retro-sprite.bio: Sixteen bits of courage in bubblegum and lemon. Press start to believe in it.

wildlife-lens.prompt: A mountain fox caught through a telephoto lens on 35mm film, creamy bokeh dissolving the crags behind, soft overcast light, earthy natural palette, thin high-country air - one patient frame from a long cold hide.
wildlife-lens.alt: A telephoto animal portrait in soft gray light
wildlife-lens.bio: Hours of stillness for one honest frame. The bokeh forgets the mountain so the fox can be everything.

dream-drift.prompt: A dreamer's silhouette double-exposed with floating islands and waterfalls, surreal dream logic bending the horizon, iridescent opal color shifting across everything, volumetric rays pouring through impossible sky - a lucid dream at full volume.
dream-drift.alt: A surreal iridescent dream among floating islands
dream-drift.bio: Sleep with the saturation up. Islands fly, color refuses to choose, and the dreamer contains the weather.

gilded-arcana.prompt: A centered symbolic figure composed like a tarot arcana rendered as a leaded stained-glass window, flowing art nouveau linework in the cames, jewel-tone light blazing through emerald and ruby panes - a fortune told in glass.
gilded-arcana.alt: A stained-glass tarot figure in jewel light
gilded-arcana.bio: Meaning you can hold to the light. The cards, the glass, and the sun conspire on the reading.

deco-metropolis.prompt: A gleaming art deco metropolis seen from directly above, gilded geometry and sunburst motifs in the avenues, vintage travel-poster optimism, hard black-and-gold contrast - the city as a jewelry box lid.
deco-metropolis.alt: A gilded deco skyline from above
deco-metropolis.bio: The skyline as ornament. Deco believed a city could be worn, and drew it from the clasp side.

clay-mascot.prompt: A cheerful squashable mascot character sculpted in claymation style with visible thumbprints, soft pastel palette, crisp softbox studio light, perfectly centered - a character sheet hero pose begging to be picked up.
clay-mascot.alt: A squashable clay character in studio light
clay-mascot.bio: Built to be squished, lit to be loved. The mascot's whole job is to survive your affection.

cinema-frame.prompt: A trench-coated figure at a fence line rim-lit against cold night, steel blue palette, rule-of-thirds framing with the background melted to bokeh, anamorphic cinematic grade - one paused frame of a thriller mid-turn.
cinema-frame.alt: A rim-lit thriller frame in steel tones
cinema-frame.bio: The frame before the reveal. Steel light, an edge of rim glow, and a background that knows too much.

woodblock-journey.prompt: A traveler with a walking staff crossing a mountain pass rendered as an ukiyo-e woodblock print, flat muted color planes, wide establishing composition, the peaks stacked in printed layers - a journey pressed into paper.
woodblock-journey.alt: A traveler's mountain crossing as a woodblock print
woodblock-journey.bio: Miles compressed to printed planes. The mountains queue politely in flat, perfect inks.

field-journal.prompt: A naturalist's field study knolled from above - specimens, pressed leaves, and tools aligned at right angles, drawn in fine crosshatched ink on sun-faded paper - a botanical journal page from a long expedition.
field-journal.alt: A naturalist's knolled ink field page
field-journal.bio: The expedition, filed at right angles. Ink for the facts, sun-fade for the years.

anime-quest.prompt: A spirited child on a grassy floating island, anime cel shading with clean linework, volumetric god rays through towering painted clouds, more islands hanging in the bright sky - the key visual for an adventure that doesn't exist yet.
anime-quest.alt: An anime key visual of a child among sky islands
anime-quest.bio: The poster for episode one of forever. Cel-shaded courage, painted sky, islands optional but included.

lone-wanderer.prompt: An empty moorland road at dusk with a solitary traveler visible in the middle distance, small but unmistakable, the land quiet around them.
lone-wanderer.alt: A cloaked wanderer on an empty winding road (distant traveler)

lone-wanderer.prompt: A lone cloaked wanderer as the clear focal point of an empty winding road, seen from behind mid-stride, cloak moving, the moor stretching away on both sides.
lone-wanderer.alt: A cloaked wanderer on an empty winding road (lone wanderer)

lone-wanderer.prompt: A tiny lone figure dwarfed by a vast empty landscape, the road a thread across an enormous plain beneath a towering sky, the wanderer a speck of resolve.
lone-wanderer.alt: A cloaked wanderer on an empty winding road (speck in the vast)

gentle-giant.prompt: A large friendly moss-backed creature resting at the edge of a meadow scene, half-curled and calm, a small figure nearby going about their day.
gentle-giant.alt: A moss-covered giant creature beside a small figure (resting colossus)

gentle-giant.prompt: A gentle giant creature towering benevolently over a meadow, a tiny human looking up at it, the creature's huge head lowered in greeting.
gentle-giant.alt: A moss-covered giant creature beside a small figure (gentle giant)

gentle-giant.prompt: A colossal benevolent titan filling the sky above the meadow, its shoulders in the clouds, the horizon bending around its bulk, the tiny figure below lit by its kind gaze.
gentle-giant.alt: A moss-covered giant creature beside a small figure (sky-filling titan)

golden-hour.prompt: A lone oak on a grassy hillside under a soft golden wash, gentle late-afternoon warmth settling over the grass, shadows only beginning to stretch.
golden-hour.alt: A lone tree on a hillside in low golden sunlight (golden wash)

golden-hour.prompt: A lone oak on a grassy hillside at full golden hour, warm directional light raking the slope, a long dramatic shadow and glowing backlit grass seed-heads.
golden-hour.alt: A lone tree on a hillside in low golden sunlight (golden hour)

golden-hour.prompt: A lone oak on a hillside at blazing sundown, the sun flaring directly into the lens behind the trunk, the whole frame ignited orange, shadow thrown clear across the land.
golden-hour.alt: A lone tree on a hillside in low golden sunlight (blazing sundown)

bioluminescence.prompt: A dark tidal cove at night, faint blue-green pinpricks of plankton dotting the shallows around a drifting rowboat, most of the scene still deep shadow.
bioluminescence.alt: Glowing organisms lighting a dark cove (faint glow)

bioluminescence.prompt: A night cove lit by living light: glowing plankton bright in the wake of a rowboat, luminous fungi on the rocks, cool blue-green glow becoming the scene's true light source.
bioluminescence.alt: Glowing organisms lighting a dark cove (living light)

bioluminescence.prompt: An abyssal cove where bioluminescence is the only light in the world, water blazing electric blue-green around the silhouetted rowboat, glowing spores drifting like stars in the black air.
bioluminescence.alt: Glowing organisms lighting a dark cove (abyssal radiance)

candlelight.prompt: A reader at a wooden table in a dim room, soft candle warmth touching their face and the book's pages, the rest of the room resting in gentle darkness.
candlelight.alt: A reader at a table lit by candle flame (candle warmth)

candlelight.prompt: A reader bent over a book, warm flickering candlelight carving the scene, wax pooling below the flame, deep shadows pressing in at the edges of the small golden circle.
candlelight.alt: A reader at a table lit by candle flame (candlelight)

candlelight.prompt: A single flame in darkness carving one face out of black, everything else gone: one candle, one hand, one page catching the light, the room entirely surrendered to shadow.
candlelight.alt: A reader at a table lit by candle flame (single flame)

moonlight.prompt: A farmhouse and field under pale moonlight, silver-blue light settling quietly over roofs and grass, the night calm and legible.
moonlight.alt: A silvered field and farmhouse under the moon (pale moon)

moonlight.prompt: A farmhouse and frosted field defined by cold blue moonlight, hard-edged silver highlights on the tin roof, deep blue shadows pooling under the eaves.
moonlight.alt: A silvered field and farmhouse under the moon (moonlight)

moonlight.prompt: A farmhouse dwarfed beneath a huge low harvest moon, the world flooded silver, every blade of frost-grass glinting, shadows printed black and sharp across the field.
moonlight.alt: A silvered field and farmhouse under the moon (harvest moon)

neon-glow.prompt: A noodle stall at night with a colored neon wash tinting the steam and counter, magenta and cyan hints in the wet pavement.
neon-glow.alt: A noodle stall drenched in neon signage light (sign wash)

neon-glow.prompt: A noodle stall lit by buzzing neon signs, hard magenta and cyan light carving the cook and the counter, saturated reflections flooding the puddled street.
neon-glow.alt: A noodle stall drenched in neon signage light (neon glow)

neon-glow.prompt: A noodle stall drowned in blinding neon from every direction, colors collapsing into pure electric signal, steam glowing pink, the wet street a mirror of burning light.
neon-glow.alt: A noodle stall drenched in neon signage light (neon flood)

harsh-noon.prompt: A whitewashed courtyard in bright midday light, a figure crossing, shadows short and definite underfoot.
harsh-noon.alt: A white courtyard under hard overhead sun (bright day)

harsh-noon.prompt: A courtyard under harsh noon sun, black geometric shadows slicing under arches, a hatted figure's shadow pooled tight at their feet, walls burning white.
harsh-noon.alt: A white courtyard under hard overhead sun (harsh noon)

harsh-noon.prompt: A courtyard bleached by merciless overhead sun, shadows reduced to razor cuts of pure black, the figure almost dissolving into glare, the sky white with heat.
harsh-noon.alt: A white courtyard under hard overhead sun (merciless sun)

overcast-soft.prompt: A fishing harbor in soft overcast light, gentle even illumination over boats and water, shadows faint and forgiving.
overcast-soft.alt: A gray-day harbor in shadowless light (soft sky)

overcast-soft.prompt: A harbor under a flat gray ceiling of cloud, completely shadowless light, every hull and rope evenly described, the water a sheet of pewter.
overcast-soft.alt: A gray-day harbor in shadowless light (overcast)

overcast-soft.prompt: A harbor swallowed by luminous fog-thick overcast, boats fading into pale layers, the light itself become the weather, horizon erased in soft white.
overcast-soft.alt: A gray-day harbor in shadowless light (luminous fog)

dramatic-rim.prompt: A boxer in a dark gym with a soft rim light lifting their silhouette gently off the background, features in half-shadow.
dramatic-rim.alt: A boxer edged in rim light against darkness (soft edge)

dramatic-rim.prompt: A boxer edged in dramatic rim lighting, a hard bright line running along shoulders and jaw, the dark gym falling away behind the burning outline.
dramatic-rim.alt: A boxer edged in rim light against darkness (dramatic rim)

dramatic-rim.prompt: A boxer as a black silhouette wearing a blazing rim of light, the edge burning like a filament, everything inside the outline surrendered to darkness.
dramatic-rim.alt: A boxer edged in rim light against darkness (burning edge)

volumetric-rays.prompt: A barn interior with faint rays of light streaking the dusty air from gaps in the boards, a horse in soft half-light.
volumetric-rays.alt: Dusty light shafts crossing a barn interior (faint rays)

volumetric-rays.prompt: A barn crossed by strong volumetric god rays, each shaft made solid by swirling dust, the horse haloed where the beams converge.
volumetric-rays.alt: Dusty light shafts crossing a barn interior (god rays)

volumetric-rays.prompt: A barn carved by massive cathedral shafts of dust-filled light, the beams like architecture, the horse small beneath columns of burning air.
volumetric-rays.alt: Dusty light shafts crossing a barn interior (cathedral shafts)

firelight.prompt: Travelers by a low campfire, distant ember glow warming the edges of their faces, the night close around them.
firelight.alt: Faces around a campfire in dancing orange light (ember glow)

firelight.prompt: Travelers lit by dancing orange firelight, flame-light moving across faces and blankets, long unstable shadows thrown onto the rocks behind.
firelight.alt: Faces around a campfire in dancing orange light (firelight)

firelight.prompt: A roaring blaze throwing wild light over the travelers, flames leaping frame-high, chaotic shadows lashing the campsite, sparks streaking the black sky.
firelight.alt: Faces around a campfire in dancing orange light (roaring blaze)

storm-light.prompt: A lighthouse under brooding storm light, the sky bruised green-gray, rain beginning, the sea dark and restless.
storm-light.alt: A lighthouse under a lightning-lit storm sky (brooding sky)

storm-light.prompt: A lighthouse lit by a lightning flash, rain glittering frozen in the burst, the tower's white flank blazing against the black sky.
storm-light.alt: A lighthouse under a lightning-lit storm sky (lightning flash)

storm-light.prompt: A lighthouse frozen in a violent white lightning strike, the world burned to blacks and blinding whites, rain suspended, the sea caught mid-crash.
storm-light.alt: A lighthouse under a lightning-lit storm sky (white strike)

studio-softbox.prompt: A ceramic vase on a seamless backdrop in clean studio lighting, soft even light describing its curve, a gentle grounded shadow.
studio-softbox.alt: A ceramic vase in clean seamless studio light (clean light)

studio-softbox.prompt: A ceramic vase in crisp softbox light on a seamless sweep, controlled highlight rolling along the glaze, the shadow placed exactly where it was decided.
studio-softbox.alt: A ceramic vase in clean seamless studio light (softbox studio)

studio-softbox.prompt: A ceramic vase in clinical high-key white, every detail evenly lit, shadows all but abolished, the object floating in pure controlled brightness.
studio-softbox.alt: A ceramic vase in clean seamless studio light (high-key white)

oil-painting.prompt: A pear on a sunlit windowsill with the soft texture of an oil painting, brushwork gentle and blended, canvas grain just perceptible.
oil-painting.alt: A pear on a windowsill painted in oils (oiled surface)

oil-painting.prompt: A pear on a windowsill as an expressive oil painting, visible confident brushstrokes shaping fruit and light, thick color laid wet into wet.
oil-painting.alt: A pear on a windowsill painted in oils (oil painting)

oil-painting.prompt: A pear on a windowsill as thick impasto oil painting, sculptural ridges of paint catching real light, the strokes standing off the surface like frosting.
oil-painting.alt: A pear on a windowsill painted in oils (impasto storm)

watercolor.prompt: A red umbrella on a rainy street tinted with delicate watercolor washes, colors thin and luminous, the paper breathing through.
watercolor.alt: A rainy street umbrella scene in watercolor (light wash)

watercolor.prompt: A red umbrella crossing a rainy street as loose watercolor painting, blooming pigment edges, wet-into-wet skies, reflections dissolving downward.
watercolor.alt: A rainy street umbrella scene in watercolor (watercolor)

watercolor.prompt: A red umbrella in wild runaway watercolor - running drips, blooms colliding, patches of raw untouched paper where the rain would be.
watercolor.alt: A rainy street umbrella scene in watercolor (runaway water)

pencil-sketch.prompt: A sleeping cat on a chair with light pencil-sketch linework, gentle graphite lines finding the curl of the body.
pencil-sketch.alt: A sleeping cat drawn in graphite pencil (light graphite)

pencil-sketch.prompt: A sleeping cat as a full graphite pencil sketch, construction lines still visible under the finished fur, hatched shadow anchoring the chair.
pencil-sketch.alt: A sleeping cat drawn in graphite pencil (pencil sketch)

pencil-sketch.prompt: A sleeping cat as a furious scribbled pencil drawing, raw and unfinished on purpose, gesture lines flying past the form, energy over accuracy.
pencil-sketch.alt: A sleeping cat drawn in graphite pencil (furious scribble)

ink-illustration.prompt: A strutting rooster traced with fine ink linework, contours clean and confident, minimal shading.
ink-illustration.alt: A rooster drawn in crosshatched pen and ink (fine line)

ink-illustration.prompt: A strutting rooster as a full pen-and-ink illustration, crosshatched shading deepening the breast and tail, line weight doing all the light.
ink-illustration.alt: A rooster drawn in crosshatched pen and ink (pen and ink)

ink-illustration.prompt: A rooster drowning in heavy black ink against stark white paper, feathers pooling into bold black shapes, highlights left as fearless white cuts.
